spans.claim: Orbit’s family lineage included criminals known as the Jessups

spans.span: His grandmother on his mother's side was the daughter of old Gideon Jessups who was hung down South for highway robbery and murder; another of his daughters died insane and two of his sons were convicts-but there's no use going into it all.
